coordination.spawn_means: Create the equivalent isolated specialist worker on the current platform after authorisation; otherwise execute roles sequentially.
coordination.merge_rule: Coordinator reviews one owned change set at a time against the frozen contracts; re-review overlapping edits before integration.

roles.specialty: authority, source freeze, decision intake and integration
event model, scientific assumptions and field protocol
schema, identity chronology, historical compatibility and validators
task state transitions, snapshot publication and report/map interpretation
independent synthetic reproduction, boundary tests and evidence

steps.action: Record clean source commit, hashes, dirty-file exclusions and permissions; read current specification and separate history.
steps.gate: Source and authority known; no protected work overwritten.

steps.action: Inspect dependency lock, reconcile missing provenance, validate recipe and reproduce reference on fresh synthetic instance.
steps.gate: No required failure; missing checks explicitly listed and prevent full acceptance.

steps.action: Create domain specialist; provide only frozen source and study brief, assign study-decisions/event-contract/manual-draft.
steps.gate: Role owns its artifacts; no unapproved scientific defaults.

steps.action: For adaptation, fill decision profile with human-approved rationale and evidence; for reference, use reference-profile without granting transfer approval.
steps.gate: Every adaptation decision approved or explicitly disabled; unresolved decisions block implementation.

steps.action: Create schema/identity specialist after event contract review; give validator protocol and reference interfaces.
steps.gate: Archive, identity, location, timestamp and validator interfaces frozen.

steps.action: Map target entities and identifiers; isolate reference-only repairs; specify tables, normalisation, evidence precedence and inspector roles. Apply only in adaptation checkout after decision gate.
steps.gate: No borrowed nest links, collapsed uncertainty or mock-only save blockers.

steps.action: Create task/report specialist using approved event and identity contracts; assign disjoint files or serialise changes to shared SQL.
steps.gate: Dependency interfaces agreed; no concurrent writers of shared SQL.

steps.action: Specify tasks, timing/closure/reactivation, publication, note vocabulary and maps; adapt in separate checkout using approved study decisions.
steps.gate: Shared SQL counts and reference-date rules preserved; every changed rule has expected fixtures.

steps.action: Review integrated implementation independently; run synthetic acceptance and target-study scenarios, browser integration if authorised, and inspect every rendered PDF page.
steps.gate: All required checks PASS; NOT RUN/NOT AVAILABLE are not equivalence or integration passes.

steps.action: Reconcile manual, machine rules, field descriptions and actual implementation; quarantine historical descriptions and document remaining discrepancies.
steps.gate: Scientific owner reviews new study procedures; examples are invented.

steps.action: Assemble source/protocol/profile/environment/acceptance manifest, safe install order and rollback; request concrete publication/deployment authority only after reviewable artifacts exist.
steps.gate: Human controls merge, deployment and live changes; local success never claims installed state.
